newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen SEG '96 net hits 143 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen SEG '96 net hits 143 mln yuan.

text.p: Shenzhen SEG Co Ltd chalked up net profits of 142.66 million yuan for the year ended December 31, 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Thursday.
Earnings per share reached 0.461 yuan and turnover was 1.66 billion yuan in 1996, the exchange said.
It did not say whether the figures were based on Chinese or international accounting standards or give comparative figures.
The company had net profits of 88.22 million yuan for 1995 on turnover of 1.75 billion yuan under Chinese standards, according to the company's A share prospectus released in December 1996.
It did not give figures based on international standards.
The company proposed a three-for-10 bonus issue based on 1996 profits, the exchange said.
Trading in the firm's A and B shares will be suspended on Friday morning for the annual result announcement and will resume in the afternoon, the exchange said.
